description: 3D-Windenergieanlagen Hamburg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung (LGV) Hamburg. The data set includes the wind turbines on Hamburg's urban area (as of 01-2025). The positions come from ALKIS or, if not available, from the 2022 ALS point cloud. Coverage: Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung (LGV) Hamburg. The portal shows the English title as "3D wind turbines Hamburg" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Landesbetrieb Geoinformation und Vermessung (LGV) Hamburg. Its keywords include Stadtmodell, Geodaten, 3D-Stadtmodell, Windenergieanlage, Windenergie, Windkraftanlage. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
